text:
Maria: Proposing cut window on 2026-04-12 09:00 PT (UTC-7). Planning a short 30m go/no-go sync at 08:30 PT same day for roll call + canary smoke. Draft agenda: 1) Roll call & signoffs (prod, infra, QA, security) 2) Canary smoke checklist & owners 3) Observability & error-budget quick checks 4) Fallback plan & model fallback config 5) Go/no-go vote. Please RSVP with +1 if you can make it, :x: if you have a conflict, or name a proxy. Add any agenda items now.

Sam: +1 for the slot. Can we start 08:00 PT instead? I want 30m margin before traffic ramp.

Zoe: :x: I'm on customer calls that morning. If you can move to 4/13 I'm free. Otherwise I'll hand off my signoff to Frank.

Frank: +1, I can cover QA signoff and run the canary tests. I'll post the canary checklist tomorrow.

Ash: +1. Need perf numbers for the canary — peak p50/p95 for the last 3 days and the test dataset. Can someone paste a quick query or link?

Maria: @Ash perf snapshot here: https://redwood.internal/ops/perf-snapshots/2026-04-09 — key metrics: p50 ~ 42ms, p95 ~ 210ms on prod-sim. I'll add to the calendar invite. Also draft canary commands below:

```
# canary smoke checklist (local run)
./run_canary --env=staging --suite=smoke --limit=200 --observe
```

Sam: Nice. Add "observability smoke" to agenda: traces, error budget, SLO check. I'll run traces during canary.

George: I'll be on call that morning, +1. I'll watch rollout and coordinate the fallback if needed.

eng-oncall: Available 08:00-10:00 PT for any emergency paging. If you expect a rapid rollback, notify on #eng-oncall and tag me.

Maria: Updated agenda to include observability smoke. Calendar invite will be out in 10m — adding Frank as QA owner, Sam for traces, George for oncall liaison, Ash for perf. @Zoe noted conflict and will proxy to Frank.

deploy-bot: Deployment window placeholder created for 2026-04-12 09:00 PT — ID: dw-20260412-09

Sam: Quick ask — can we attach the canary test list to the invite? Makes it easier to follow during the sync.

Frank: Will attach the canary checklist and the minimal runbook. Also will paste the smoke test names here before EOD.

Maria: Thanks all. If anyone else needs to be looped in (security, infra owners), reply here. Otherwise RSVP +1 in the calendar when you get the invite. :thumbsup:

Zoe: Thanks — estimated proxy plan noted. Good luck y'all
